description: The `(req, res) => {}` function passed to `createServer`. Node calls it once per request.
`req`: a readable stream with `method`, `url` (path + query) and lowercase `headers`. The body arrives as chunks.
`res`: a writable stream. Set `statusCode`/headers first, then write the body and call `res.end()`.
Header that tells the client how to parse the body. JSON APIs send `application/json`.
Thrown when you set a header or status after the body started: headers always travel before the body.
`new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')` splits `pathname` and `searchParams`; the base is required because `req.url` is relative.
